question: Which of the following is a T-shaped intra-uterine contraceptive device that offers long-term (multi-year) birth control?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper-T**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Copper-T** is a T-shaped intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) used for long-term birth control. It is inserted into the uterus to prevent pregnancy and can remain effective for up to **10-12 years**, depending on the model.
 
• This device functions by releasing **copper ions**, which are toxic to sperm, thereby reducing their mobility and viability. This prevents fertilization of the egg.
 
• It is one of the most effective contraceptive methods, with a success rate of over **99%**, making it a reliable option for long-term contraception.
 
• Copper-T does not rely on hormones for its functionality, making it suitable for women who cannot or prefer not to use hormonal contraceptives. It also does not interfere with lactation, making it a viable option for breastfeeding women.
 
• The device is inserted by a trained healthcare professional and requires minimal maintenance. However, regular check-ups are advised to ensure it remains in place and effective.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Male Condom:**

 
 
• The male condom is a barrier contraceptive method. It is a thin sheath typically made of latex or polyurethane, designed to cover the penis during intercourse.
 
• It provides dual protection by preventing pregnancy and reducing the risk of sexually transmitted infections (STIs), including HIV.
 
• It is a single-use contraceptive and is widely available without a prescription.
 
 
 
• **Birth Control Pills:**
 
 
• Birth control pills, also known as oral contraceptives, are hormonal pills containing synthetic forms of estrogen and/or progesterone.
 
• These pills prevent ovulation and thicken cervical mucus to block sperm entry.
 
• They must be taken daily at the same time for maximum effectiveness and offer no protection against STIs.
 
 
 
• **Diaphragm:**
 
 
• The diaphragm is a dome-shaped barrier contraceptive device made of silicone or latex. It is inserted into the vagina to cover the cervix and prevent sperm from entering the uterus.
 
• It is used with spermicide for enhanced effectiveness and must be placed before intercourse and left in place for at least six hours afterward.
 
• It provides no protection against STIs and must be fitted by a healthcare provider for proper sizing.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of Copper-T:**
 
 
• It provides long-term contraception without requiring daily or periodic attention.
 
• It does not interfere with sexual activity, making it convenient for users.
 
• It is cost-effective over time compared to other contraceptive methods.
 
• Fertility can return quickly after removal of the device.
